ordinary.pc_reserve_basis: DE_LU / FCR [symmetric]: Project Case uses six nominal 4h capacity blocks per local day, including DST, with availability applied. Energy and SoC use physical delivery time; screening capacity uses elapsed hours without this adjustment.
ordinary.summary_joint_basis: DE_LU / aggregate capacity: FCR: physical-hour screening; capacity cash uses elapsed delivery hours and availability, with no nominal-block DST adjustment. Energy/SoC use physical time. The registered DE_LU Project Case profile uses six nominal 4h blocks/day.
